summary: Integrated the validated PR #15 Model Selection Trace implementation onto the latest main (merge f364791 + ACTIVE-only chore). The eight authorized files are integrated: the six PR#15-only files (src/hub/index.mjs, src/jobs.mjs, src/model-routing.mjs, test/model-routing.test.mjs, test/model-selection-trace.test.mjs [new], test/role-routing.test.mjs) applied with PR#15's ready-validated semantics while keeping main's CRLF convention (zero EOL churn verified: plain diff equals git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol); the two overlapping files (src/mcp-runtime.mjs, src/workflow-runtime.mjs) were manually merged so PR#15's selection_trace/transport enrichment is combined with latest-main structured error_code propagation, failure classification (classifyFailure), terminal-code promotion and live runtime controls - none of the later-main lines were reverted. Deterministic validation PASS: node --test test/*.test.mjs 395/395 (353 main tests + the restored PR#15 trace tests) and pnpm run build:client PASS (generated lib/client.js restored). Real execution on the integrated source: the source boots as a disposable current-source DSH Hub (127.0.0.1:3213, /runtime 0.3.0-dev protocol 1) and a genuine Hub attempt (hub-1-mt2zi8nh, opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash, preferred-default) emitted selection_trace version=1 with all 11 required fields, selected.provider/model/source exactly matching the executed attempt, and a zero-hit recursive sensitivity scan; the Hub job view itself carries selection_trace (hub-side emission verified). The worker's inference completion is BLOCKED by DSH_ENVIRONMENT: ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml was rewritten (by the running web DSH, unrelated to this change) into a version/refs envelope whose `version` is a non-string, which dsh-credentials-local 0.1.0-rc.7 rejects at new-profile boot, and the task forbids modifying or duplicating persistent credentials - so the disposable hub's worker attempt fails at opencode-go auth (EXECUTION_FAILED/max_attempts_reached). The completed-worker trace contract is covered by restored deterministic tests; only a genuine completed live worker remains blocked by that environment defect.

tests.evidence: One genuine Hub attempt on the integrated source: hub-1-mt2zi8nh (provider opencode-go, model deepseek-v4-flash, selection_source preferred-default). Integrated Hub job view itself carries selection_trace (hub-side emission via integrated hub/jobs/model-routing). child_attempts[0].selection_trace: version=1 with all 11 required fields (role, logical_attempt=0, model_class_hint=flash, strategy=balanced, candidate_set=primary, ordered_candidates[deepseek-official skipped PREFERRED_MODEL_AMBIGUOUS, opencode-go selected], selected{opencode-go,deepseek-v4-flash,preferred-default}, selection_source, fallback_reason=null, escalation_reason=null); selected.provider/model/source EXACTLY equals the executed attempt; logical_attempt matches; recursive sensitivity scan 0 hits (no creds/tokens/sensitive paths; only bounded identifiers/enums/reason codes)

tests.name: T10 Genuine COMPLETED Hub/MCP worker on the integrated branch
tests.evidence: Blocker (DSH_ENVIRONMENT, unrelated to the integration): ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml was rewritten (by the running DSH web process) into a version/refs envelope whose root `version` value is a non-string; dsh-credentials-local 0.1.0-rc.7 requires every root value to be a string, so any NEW profile boot fails at [cordis.init]. The task forbids modifying or duplicating persistent DSH credentials, so the disposable current-source hub's worker cannot authenticate its opencode-go inference call: the real attempt hub-1-mt2zi8nh was selected correctly but the attempt ended EXECUTION_FAILED / terminal_reason max_attempts_reached. The completed-worker trace contract is covered by the restored deterministic model-selection-trace.test.mjs. Recommended fix (out of scope): correct the credentials file's `version` to a string (or restore the prior flat format), then re-run the completed-worker live smoke.
